name: Garage
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Garage is lightweight, S3-compatible object storage. The egg runs it as one node with the S3 API on the server's port; type Garage's commands in the console to make keys and buckets.
startup: [ -x garage ] || { echo "Reinstall the server to download Garage."; exit 1; }; export RUST_LOG="${RUST_LOG:-warn,garage=info,garage_util=warn,garage_net=warn,garage_table=warn,garage_api_admin=warn,garage_rpc=warn,garage_model=warn,garage_db=warn}"; set -f; g() { ./garage -c garage.toml "$@"; }; (trap - INT TERM; exec ./garage -c garage.toml server) & pid=$!; trap ':' INT; trap 'kill -INT $pid 2>/dev/null' TERM; (for i in $(seq 30); do sleep 2; l=$(g layout show 2>&1) && break; done; case "$l" in *"Current cluster layout version: 0"*) id=$(g node id -q 2>/dev/null); g layout assign -z dc1 -c "{{CAPACITY}}" "${id%%@*}" > /dev/null && g layout apply --version 1 > /dev/null && echo "Garage is set up as one node with {{CAPACITY}} of storage." ;; esac; echo "Type Garage's commands in the console, such as: key create my-key, bucket create my-bucket, bucket allow --read --write --owner my-bucket --key my-key") & while kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; do if read -r -t 1 line; then [ -z "$line" ] || g $line; elif [ $? -le 128 ]; then sleep 1; fi; done; wait $pid

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Garage: downloads Garage's official release build for the chosen version
# (garagehq.deuxfleurs.fr) and writes a first garage.toml for a single
# node, with its own RPC secret. The data, the metadata and garage.toml are
# never touched once there.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) platform=x86_64-unknown-linux-musl ;;
    aarch64) platform=aarch64-unknown-linux-musl ;;
    *) fail "Garage has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

releases=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)" https://garagehq.deuxfleurs.fr/_releases.json) ||
    fail "garagehq.deuxfleurs.fr can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
list=$(jq -r '.[] | select(.name == "Release") | .builds[].version' <<<"$releases")
latest=$(head -n 1 <<<"$list")
version="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$version" = latest ]; then version="$latest"; else version="v${version#v}"; fi
build=$(jq -c --arg v "$version" --arg p "$platform" '.[] | select(.name == "Release") | .builds[] | select(.version == $v) | .builds[] | select(.platform == $p)' <<<"$releases")
[ -n "$build" ] || fail "Garage has no release $version. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as ${latest#v}, then reinstall."

if [ -x garage ] && [ "$(cat .garage-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "Garage $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Garage $version."
    url=$(jq -r .url <<<"$build")
    size=$(jq -r .size <<<"$build")
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)" -o "$work/garage" "$url" ||
        fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    # Garage publishes no checksums: check the size it lists, and that it runs.
    [ "$(stat -c %s "$work/garage")" = "$size" ] && chmod 0755 "$work/garage" && "$work/garage" --version > /dev/null ||
        fail "The download is incomplete. Reinstall to try again."
    mv -f "$work/garage" garage
    echo "$version" > .garage-version
fi

mkdir -p data meta
if [ ! -f garage.toml ]; then
    secret=$(head -c 32 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')
    cat > garage.toml <<TOML
# Garage's settings: https://garagehq.deuxfleurs.fr/documentation/reference-manual/configuration/
# One node keeping one copy of each object. The S3 API's port is set by the
# server's settings. Restart the server after changing this file.
metadata_dir = "/home/container/meta"
data_dir = "/home/container/data"
db_engine = "lmdb"
metadata_auto_snapshot_interval = "6h"
replication_factor = 1

rpc_bind_addr = "127.0.0.1:3901"
rpc_public_addr = "127.0.0.1:3901"
rpc_secret = "$secret"

[s3_api]
s3_region = "garage"
api_bind_addr = "[::]:${SERVER_PORT:-3900}"
root_domain = ".s3.garage.localhost"
TOML
fi
echo "Installed Garage $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Garage version to install, such as 2.5.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Storage capacity
variables.description: How much storage the node offers, such as 100G or 2T, set on the first start. Change it later with layout assign in the console.
